harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a persistent Python 2.4-compatible inventory web tier on CentOS 5.11. node2 and node3 serve inventory data on port 8080; node1 load-balances port 80 traffic round-robin across both. All three nodes passed sequential reboot and recovery verification without changing the OS release or kernel.
actions_performed: Installed and enabled SysV-managed inventory-web services on node2 and node3.
Installed and enabled a SysV-managed round-robin reverse proxy on node1.
Persisted firewall access for node1 port 80 and node1-to-backend port 8080 traffic.
Verified backend health, inventory HTML/API responses, and alternating load-balanced requests.
Restarted node1, node2, and node3 individually and verified changed boot identities and full recovery after each restart.
Verified traffic remained available through node3 while node2 rebooted and through node2 while node3 rebooted.

evidence.summary: node2 is enabled at boot, listening on 0.0.0.0:8080, healthy, and serving inventory HTML and API data.
node3 is enabled at boot, listening on 0.0.0.0:8080, healthy, and serving inventory HTML and API data.

evidence.requirement: node1 load-balances HTTP port 80 across both backends
evidence.summary: node1 is enabled at boot and listening on port 80; six successive requests alternated node2/node3, with both direct backend health checks succeeding.

evidence.requirement: Legacy OS release and kernel retained
evidence.summary: Every node remains on CentOS 5.11 with kernel 2.6.18-398.el5.

Baseline and acknowledgement recorded boot ID db6c3e58-d43a-4108-8000-000000000000; recovery showed changed ID b638db7c-873f-428b-8000-000000000000, restored port 80 listener/firewall, and successful responses from both backends.
Boot ID changed from 76f41f81-ca90-43fe-8000-000000000000 to 0af1c809-5f46-4dbc-8000-000000000000; service, port 8080, firewall, inventory data, and load-balancer membership recovered.
Boot ID changed from 6f14d300-b559-4446-8000-000000000000 to 03b28ec1-154a-4ec5-8000-000000000000; service, port 8080, firewall, inventory data, and load-balancer membership recovered.
Four requests remained successful through node3 while node2 rebooted, and four remained successful through node2 while node3 rebooted.
